mostWorthwhile.text: Loading the second core was most worthwhile: seeing the folded outline again connected the practical transfer to the discovery and preserved its surrounding ice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the two cores in separate steps felt somewhat repetitive, even though their separate cradles made physical sense.

surprise.text: The carrier's transfer buffer explicitly bridged the move to active flight refrigeration, clarifying how the cores stayed cold.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each had a clear role in chilling, separating or securing the specimens.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what the receiving laboratories learn about the articulated body; this chapter ends with the specimens secured rather than resolving the discovery.
